source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 14 (Atmosphere) ki exercise hal ke saath (PDF 320-322): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Atmosphere) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. Which gas causes yellow color in photochemical smog?
(Photochemical smog mein peela rang kis gas ki wajah se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: NO₂ peeli-bhoori gas hai. Photochemical smog mein gaariyon ki NO, NO₂ mein oxidize hoti hai (2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂), jo smog ko peela-bhoora rang deti hai (14.4.2, 14.6.1). CO, SO₂ aur SO₃ be-rang hain.

blocks.prompt:
II. The depletion of Ozone in stratosphere region is mainly due to the reaction of O₃ with:
(Stratosphere mein ozone ki kami zyada tar O₃ ke kis ke saath reaction se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CFCs stratosphere mein pohanch kar UV roshni se toot'te aur chlorine free radicals dete hain: CFCl₃ → CFCl₂ + Cl•, phir Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂. Cl• dobara azad ho kar bohat se O₃ molecules khatam karta hai (14.4.6).

blocks.prompt:
III. Which particulate matter size is considered the most harmful to human health?
(Particulate matter ka kaun sa size insani sehat ke liye sab se zyada nuqsan deh samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: PM 2.5 (2.5 μm ya is se chhote bareek zarrat) sab se nuqsan deh particulate matter ka maana hua paimana hai: yeh phephron mein gehrai tak aur khoon tak ja sakte hain (chapter se aage). PM 10 zyada tar naak aur gale mein ruk jate hain. (1 μm ke zarrat bhi PM 2.5 mein shamil hain.)

blocks.prompt:
IV. Which of the following is a natural factor that can improve air quality?
(In mein se kaun si qudrati cheez hawa ka mayaar behtar kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barish hawa se particulate matter aur hal hone wali gases dho deti hai. Jangal ki aag dhuan aur PM chhorti hai (14.8.1); shehr phailna aur karkhanon ka dhuan insani factors hain jo hawa kharab karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
V. What is a common human activity that led to increased level of carbon monoxide in the atmosphere?
(Kaun si aam insani sargarmi fiza mein carbon monoxide barhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO fossil fuels ke adhoore jalne se banti hai (2C + O₂ → 2CO); gaariyon ke engine is ka bara zariya hain (14.4.1, 14.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
VI. Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) have been primarily used in …….
(Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) zyada tar kis mein istemal hote rahe hain?)
blocks.explanation: CFCs gas ya kam boiling point wale liquids hain jo aerosol spray mein aur fridge aur AC mein thanda karne ke liye istemal hote hain (14.4.6).

blocks.prompt:
VII. What are the primary chemical processes that removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere?
(Fiza se carbon dioxide nikalne wala bunyadi chemical amal kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis mein sabz paude CO₂ le kar carbohydrates banate hain; jangal CO₂ jazb karte hain (14.5.2). Jalna, saans lena aur aatish fishan CO₂ barhate hain.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. An AQI value between 51 and 100 typically indicates which level of air quality?
(AQI 51 se 100 ke darmiyan ho to hawa ka mayaar kis darje ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 14.2: 0–50 achha (sabz), 51–100 moderate (darmiyana, peela), 101–150 hassas logon ke liye ghair sehatmand, 151–200 ghair sehatmand, 201–300 bohat ghair sehatmand, 301–500 khatarnak.

blocks.prompt:
IX. Acid rain is primarily caused by the release of which of the following gases into the atmosphere?
(Tezabi barish (acid rain) zyada tar fiza mein kin gases ke chhorne se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels jalne se SOₓ aur NOₓ nikalti hain jo nami ke saath H₂SO₄, HNO₃ aur HNO₂ banati hain (14.6.2).

blocks.prompt:
X. In the presence of sunlight and nitrogen oxides (NOₓ), VOCs can contribute to the formation of:
(Dhoop aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ki maujoodgi mein VOCs kis ke banne mein hissa lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: NOₓ, VOCs aur na-jale hydrocarbons dhoop mein photochemical reactions se ozone aur PAN banate hain: photochemical smog (14.6.1).

blocks.prompt:
XI. Primary pollutants like nitrogen oxides (NOx ) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) react in the presence of sunlight to form a key component of photochemical smog, which is a:
(NOx aur VOCs jaise primary pollutants dhoop mein react kar ke photochemical smog ka ek aham juz banate hain. Yeh kya hai?)

options.text: Qudrati tor par fiza ki gas

blocks.explanation: Jo cheez primary pollutants ke chemical reactions se bane woh secondary pollutant hai (14.2); photochemical smog ki ozone aur PAN secondary pollutants hain (14.6.1).

blocks.prompt:
XII. A key component that distinguishes photochemical smog from industrial smog is the presence of:
(Photochemical smog ko industrial smog se alag karne wala aham juz kis ki maujoodgi hai?)

options.text: Ozone aur PAN (peroxyacetyl nitrate) jaise photochemical oxidants ki kafi miqdar
Dhund aur dhuen ke zarrat se kam nazar aana

blocks.explanation: Photochemical smog mein dhoop se bane secondary pollutants jaise ozone aur PAN hote hain (14.6.1). Zyada SO₂ industrial (classical, London) smog ki nishani hai; kam nazar aana dono mein hota hai.

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)
Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Identify and briefly explain three major natural sources of air pollutants.
Air pollutants ke teen bare qudrati zariye pehchanein aur mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Aatish fishan (volcanic eruptions): bohat zyada gases aur particulate matter (raakh) chhorte hain.
2. Bijli kadakna (lightning): bari miqdar mein nitrogen ke oxides (NOₓ) banati hai.
3. Gard aur hayatiyati maadda: hawa ka kataao aur aandhiyan PM barhati hain; pollen, spores aur janwaron ke zarrat hawa mein hote hain.
(Mazeed: samandar ki algae H₂S, dalaldal CH₄, jangal ki aag dhuan deti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
b. How can deforestation impact air quality?
Jangalat ki kataai (deforestation) hawa ke mayaar par kaise asar dalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jangal CO₂ aur doosri greenhouse gases jazb kar ke hawa saaf karte hain. Inhein kaatne se hawa mein CO₂ barhti hai, mausami tabdeeli barhti hai, aur gard rokne wale darakht khatam ho jate hain; saaf ki gayi lakri jalane se dhuan, CO₂ aur PM bhi nikalte hain. Nangi zameen se gard urti hai.

blocks.prompt:
c. Explain the reasons for the temperature trends observed in the troposphere and the stratosphere.
Troposphere aur stratosphere mein temperature ke rujhan ki wajah bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Troposphere (0–12 km): unchai ke saath temperature taqreeban 17 °C se −58 °C tak girta hai, kyun ke yeh tabqa neeche zameen ki satah se garam hota hai; oopar ki hawa us garmi se door hai (aur phail kar thandi hoti hai, chapter se aage).
Stratosphere (12–50 km): temperature −58 °C se −2 °C tak barhta hai, kyun ke ozone tez UV shuaain jazb karti hai (O₃ → O₂ + O) aur ozone ka dobara banna (O₂ + O → O₃) exothermic hai, yani garmi deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
d. Describe four significant anthropogenic (human-caused) activities that contribute to the deterioration of air quality. For each activity, name at least one major pollutant released.
Hawa ka mayaar kharab karne wali chaar bari insani sargarmiyan bayan karein, aur har ek se nikalne wala kam az kam ek bara pollutant batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Gaariyan (petrol aur diesel jalana): CO, NOₓ, na-jale hydrocarbons, VOCs, PM.
2. Bijli ghar aur karkhane jo coal aur tel jalate hain: SO₂ (SOₓ), NOₓ, CO₂.
3. Lakri ko eendhan ke tor par jalana, bhatton mein coal, aur fasal ki baqiyat aur kachra khule mein jalana: dhuan, PM, CO.
4. Fridge, AC aur aerosol mein CFCs: CFCs (ozone ghatati hain).
(Mazeed: jangalat ki kataai (CO₂ zyada); khaad (N₂O); dhaat saazi, batteries aur kachra jalana (Pb, Hg, Cd).)

blocks.prompt:
e. What are the environmental impacts of persistent organic pollutants (POPs)?
Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) ke mahol par kya asraat hain?
blocks.explanation: POPs chemical, hayatiyati aur roshni se tootne ka muqabla karte hain, is liye mahol mein lambe arse tak rehte aur jama hote jate hain. Yeh insanon aur janwaron ke liye zehreele hain, aur hawa aur paani inhein istemal ki jagah se door tak le jate hain (maslan PCBs, DDT). Yeh jandaron aur food chain mein jama hote hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
f. How does polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAHs) affect human health?
Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) insani sehat ko kaise mutasir karte hain?
blocks.explanation: PAHs (maslan naphthalene, anthracene) coal, tel, petrol aur lakri ke adhoore jalne, gaariyon ke dhuen aur grill kiye khane se bante hain. Yeh zehreele aur carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) hain; aaloodah hawa mein lamba waqt saans lene se phephron ke cancer ka khatra barhta hai (14.4.7, 14.10.1).

blocks.prompt:
g. What is photochemical smog? Under what conditions, it forms?
Photochemical smog kya hai? Yeh kin halaat mein banti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Photochemical smog (Los Angeles smog) woh dhundla pan hai jo primary pollutants NOₓ, VOCs aur na-jale hydrocarbons ke dhoop mein photochemical reactions se banta hai, aur ozone aur PAN jaise secondary pollutants bante hain.
Halaat: gaariyon ka zyada dhuan (NOₓ, hydrocarbons), tez dhoop, aur ruki hui garam hawa jo pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb rakhe.

blocks.prompt:
h. What type of data do air quality index (AQI) system provide?
Air quality index (AQI) nizam kis qisam ka data deta hai?
blocks.explanation: AQI kisi khaas jagah ki hawa mein pollutants (PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃) ki miqdar ko 0 se 500 tak ek number mein deta hai, sehat ke khatre ke darje aur rang ke saath: 0–50 achha, 51–100 darmiyana, … 301–500 khatarnak (Table 14.2). Is se pata chalta hai kis ko khatra hai aur bahar rehna mehfooz hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt:
i. Distinguish between PM₁₀ and PM₂.₅, specifying the size ranges and describing why PM₂.₅ is generally considered more harmful to human health.
PM₁₀ aur PM₂.₅ mein size ke saath farq bataein, aur wazeh karein ke PM₂.₅ zyada nuqsan deh kyun samjha jata hai.
blocks.explanation: PM₂.₅ zyada nuqsan deh hai kyun ke is ke nanhe zarrat naak aur gale se guzar kar phephron ki gehrai tak, balke khoon tak pohanch jate hain, aur asthma, bronchitis, dil ki bimari aur phephron ka cancer karte hain (14.9.1, 14.10.1; gehrai tak jana chapter se aage).

rows: 10 μm ya is se chhote zarrat (mote zarrat 2.5–10 μm)
2.5 μm ya is se chhote zarrat (bareek zarrat)
Zyada tar gard, pollen, samandari namak, mitti
Zyada tar jalne ka dhuan, kalikh, gaariyon ka dhuan
Zyada tar naak aur gale mein ruk jate hain
Phephron ki gehrai aur khoon tak pohanchte hain

blocks.prompt:
j. What are the main chemical processes involved in the formation of acid rain?
Tezabi barish banne ke bare chemical amal kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
Sulfur oxides: 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g); SO₃(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₄(aq)
Nitrogen oxides: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO (zyada temperature); 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂; 2NO₂(g) + H₂O(l) → HNO₃(aq) + HNO₂(aq)
Yeh acids barish mein hal ho kar us ka pH 5.6 se neeche le aate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein NO + H₂O → HNO₃ + HNO₂ chhapa hai jo ghalat hai; exam mein 2NO₂ + H₂O → HNO₃ + HNO₂ likhein. Aur acid rain ka pH 5.6 se kam hota hai ("5-6" nahi).

blocks.prompt:
k. What are the specific measures to control smog?
Smog control karne ke khaas iqdamaat kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Fasal ki baqiyat aur kachra khule mein jalane par pabandi.
2. PM kam karne ke liye smog towers aur doosri technology.
3. Gaariyon ke emission standards ka nifaz; saaf eendhan (CNG, LPG) aur kam sulphur wala diesel; catalytic converters.
4. Karkhanon ka ikhraj control (scrubbers, saaf tareeqa-e-paidawar).
5. Public transport, sabz patti (green belts) aur kam traffic rash.

blocks.prompt:
l. How does a catalytic converter reduce harmful vehicle emissions?
Catalytic converter gaariyon ke nuqsan deh ikhraj ko kaise kam karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh gaari ke exhaust mein laga hota hai; is ka catalyst nuqsan deh gases ko be-zarar mein badalta hai:
1. CO oxidize ho kar CO₂ (2CO + O₂ → 2CO₂).
2. NOₓ reduce ho kar N₂ (maslan 2NO + 2CO → N₂ + 2CO₂, chapter se aage).
3. Na-jale hydrocarbons oxidize ho kar CO₂ aur H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
m. Describe the sources of lead and mercury pollution.
Lead aur mercury ki aaloodgi ke zariye bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Lead aur mercury karkhanon ke amal, transport aur doosri insani sargarmiyon se hawa mein aate hain; dhaat saazi (metals pighlana), batteries ka kachra aur kachra jalana bare zariye hain (14.4.11).
Lead: lead-acid batteries banana aur dobara istemal, smelting, purana lead wala petrol (chapter se aage).
Mercury: coal jalana, kachra jalana (maslan thermometer, bulb), dhaat ka kaam (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Discuss sources and effects of following air pollutants on environment:
i) Heavy metals ii) VOCs iii) PAHs iv) POPs
In air pollutants ke zariye aur mahol par asraat bayan karein: i) Heavy metals ii) VOCs iii) PAHs iv) POPs
blocks.explanation:
i) Heavy metals (Pb, Hg, Cd)
Zariye: karkhanon ke amal, transport, dhaat saazi, batteries ka kachra aur kachra jalana.
Asraat: zehreele hain, toot'te nahi aur mitti, paani aur jandaron mein jama hote hain (chapter se aage); heavy metals ke namak nigalna zehr hai (Chapter 16 first aid).
ii) Volatile organic compounds (VOCs)
Organic compounds ka bara group jo kamre ke temperature par aasani se bukharat ban jate hain, maslan benzene, toluene, xylene, ethanol, formaldehyde, acetone.
Zariye: maaye eendhan, gaariyon ka dhuan, fossil fuels, lakri aur kachra jalana.
Asraat: thore arse mein aankh, naak, gale mein jalan, sar dard, matli; lambe arse mein jigar, gurde aur central nervous system ko nuqsan. Dhoop mein NOₓ ke saath photochemical smog (ozone, PAN) banate hain; andar aur bahar ki hawa aaloodah karte hain.
iii) Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs)
Jure hue aromatic rings wale compounds, maslan naphthalene, anthracene, phenanthrene.
Zariye: coal, tel, petrol aur lakri ka adhoora jalna; gaariyan; sanat; grill kiya khana; petroleum aur coal ka qudrati risao, khule mein jalana.
Asraat: zehreele aur carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale); phephron ke cancer ka khatra.
iv) Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
Organic compounds jo chemical, hayatiyati aur roshni se tootne ka muqabla karte hain, maslan PCBs (bijli ka saaman, ink, gond, paint) aur DDT (keera maar dawa).
Zariye: sanati chemicals aur pesticides.
Asraat: mahol mein lambe arse tak reh kar jama hote hain, insanon aur janwaron ke liye zehreele hain, aur hawa aur paani inhein door, doosre mulkon tak le jate hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein "phenanthracene" chhapa hai; durust naam phenanthrene hai. DDT ka poora naam dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Write short notes on the following:
i) CFCs and ozone layer depletion ii) Greenhouse effect and global warming
In par mukhtasar notes likhein: i) CFCs aur ozone layer ki kami ii) Greenhouse effect aur global warming
blocks.explanation:
i) CFCs aur ozone layer ki kami
Stratosphere mein ozone ki miqdar kam hona ozone depletion hai. Is ki bari wajah chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) hain jo aerosol spray aur fridge mein istemal hote hain. CFCs stratosphere mein ja kar UV roshni se toot'te aur chlorine free radicals azad karte hain:
CFCl₃ → CFCl₂ + Cl• (UV)
Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂
ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂
Aakhri step mein bana Cl• phir naye O₃ molecule par hamla karta hai; aakhri do steps baar baar hote hain, is liye ek CFC molecule 100,000 tak ozone molecules khatam kar sakta hai. Ozone kam hone se zyada nuqsan deh UV zameen tak pohanchti hai (chapter se aage: jild ka cancer, aankhon ko nuqsan).
ii) Greenhouse effect aur global warming
Greenhouse gases ke kambal jaise asar se zameen ki satah ka barhta garam hona greenhouse effect hai. Greenhouse gases (CO₂, paani ki bhaap, CH₄, N₂O, CFCs) suraj ki chhoti wavelength wali shuaon ko guzarne deti hain, magar garam zameen se nikalne wali lambi wavelength (infrared, garmi) ko jazb kar ke rok leti hain. In ki miqdar jitni zyada, utni zyada garmi qaid. Global warming insani sargarmiyon, khaas tor par fossil fuels jalane se greenhouse gases ke ikhraj (aur jangalat ki kataai) se zameen ke ausat temperature ka lamba barhna hai. Is se mausami tabdeeli aati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter mein teesra step ClO• + O₂ → Cl• + O₂ chhapa hai jo balanced nahi; durust ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ hai (oxygen ka akela atom).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 How the fossil fuel burning causes acid rain? Discuss in detail with chemical reactions.
Fossil fuels jalane se tezabi barish kaise hoti hai? Chemical reactions ke saath tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Acid rain woh barish (ya barf, ole, dhund) hai jis ka pH 5.6 se kam ho. Saaf barish bhi hal shuda CO₂ ki wajah se thori tezabi (taqreeban 5.6) hoti hai.
Bijli gharon, karkhanon aur gaariyon mein coal, tel aur petrol jalane se SOₓ aur NOₓ nikalti hain. Yeh hawa ki nami se mil kar acids banati hain, aur hawa in qatron ko girne se pehle door tak le jati hai.
1. Sulfuric acid: eendhan ka sulfur jal kar SO₂ banta hai:
S(s) + O₂(g) → SO₂(g)
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g)
SO₃(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₄(aq)
2. Nitric acid: engine aur bhatti ke zyada temperature par:
N₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO(g)
2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g)
2NO₂(g) + H₂O(l) → HNO₃(aq) + HNO₂(aq)
Asraat: acid rain dekhne, chhoone aur chakhne mein saaf barish jaisi hai magar corrosive (khurchne wali) hai; imaraton, pulon, mahol (ecosystem), faslon aur jheelon ki aabi hayat ko nuqsan deti hai (14.6.2, 14.16.1).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: S + O₂ → SO₂ wali equation chapter mein nahi chhapi, magar "fossil fuel mein sulfur jalta hai" dikhane ke liye exam mein likhna faida mand hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 What is meant by air quality AQI? Describe the factors affecting the air quality.
Air quality AQI se kya murad hai? Hawa ke mayaar par asar dalne wale factors bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Hawa ka mayaar Air Quality Index (AQI) se naapa jata hai, jo kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki miqdar ka paimana hai. Achhi hawa saaf hoti hai, thore zarrat aur pollutants ke saath; kharab hawa dhundli aur khatarnak hoti hai.
AQI darje (Table 14.2): 0–50 achha (sabz); 51–100 darmiyana (peela); 101–150 hassas logon ke liye ghair sehatmand (orange); 151–200 ghair sehatmand (laal); 201–300 bohat ghair sehatmand (jamni); 301–500 khatarnak (maroon). 50 se kam par bahar rehna mehfooz hai; 300 se oopar khatarnak hai, khaas tor par bachon, 65 saal se bare logon, dil aur phephron ke mareezon aur bahar kaam karne walon ke liye. AQI nephelometer jaise aalaat se naapa jata hai.
Hawa ke mayaar ke factors:
1. Ikhraj ke zariye: lakri aur fossil fuels jalana; karkhane aur bijli ghar SOₓ aur NOₓ, gaariyan CO, PM aur VOCs chhorti hain.
2. Mausami halaat: hawa, temperature aur nami pollutants ke phailao par asar karte hain; garam hawa ki tah pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb qaid kar sakti hai.
3. Qudrati waqiat: jangal ki aag dhuan aur PM, aandhiyan gard barhati hain.
4. Mausam ki tabdeeli: imaraton ko garam ya thanda karne se ikhraj barhta hai; mausami pollen hawa kharab karta hai.

rows: Hassas logon ke liye ghair sehatmand (orange)
